svg.title: Field and File: the whole CAP case
svg.desc: A holistic case map connecting business context, personas, technology context, use cases, application, machine learning and Azure infrastructure, with human authority and cross-cutting governance.

text.tspan: A whole case, not just an application.
Business transformation + public-service journey + governed technology and evidence
Fictional Hungarian CAP case | Proposed target and process map | Not a deployment record or a universal straight-through pipeline
Correct, timely support with accountable controls
Complex rules, delays and finite review capacity
inspection cost. Targets, not achieved results.
Fair access, farmer trust and reproducible audit
Case authority: caseworker + legal / sanctions officer
Leadership: programme owner + ministry policy official
Scrutiny: auditor + privacy / AI / compliance + farmer association
Enablers: platform / security + geospatial / data science
National eID / eIDAS; workforce Entra ID
Authoritative LPIS / IACS inputs + CAP guidance
Copernicus Sentinel-1/2 and approved data layers
Claimant photos + independent ground / drone facts
Existing payment / treasury system and ledger
Governed interfaces, not all integrations built
Routine path or focused farmer response
Inspection only if needed or selected
Independent control: claim population -> locked random / stratified sample -> independent findings -> case review; targeted selection is a separate route.
Authorised ground / drone findings rejoin the same case. Farmer evidence never replaces independent validation. Not every claim needs a visit.
Sentinel time series + governed labels; no future-data leakage
Feedback -> new evaluated candidate, never automatic promotion
Azure ML: custom classifier. Copernicus: appropriate raster work
Accessible farmer PWA + staff / inspector field experience
BFF -> case / evidence APIs -> versioned rules + workflows
Bounded agents: guide, monitor, resolve, prioritise, draft audit
Managed Foundry: language / reasoning / embeddings, not in AKS
Separate prediction, official case and conversation state
Receipts are not proof; model text cannot bypass authorised tools
Deterministic payment adapter <-> existing treasury / ledger
Azure enables the services; it does not own public decisions
THROUGHOUT / GOVERNANCE, RIGHTS, ASSURANCE & OPERATING LIFECYCLE
Audit lineage + appeal / reassessment | Privacy / EU geography | Accessibility | Independent assurance | Reliability, cost and recovery | Policy / scientific ownership
Measure outcomes -> review feedback -> approve changes -> improve next season. No LLM entitlement / adverse decisions or payment execution.
